integrity: Proof and exact finite-field verification supplied; computations validate bounded instances rather than the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Only nonunital radicals of diamond posets with at least two incomparable middle points; square-preserving means preservation of every square even in characteristic two. Published classifying results for niltriangular rings were not fully accessible and priority is not independently established.
title: Orthogonal Jordan symmetries of diamond incidence radicals: exact groups and derivation defects
